name: Fast-ACVNet
plain: A stereo network by Gangwei Xu et al. that uses attention-selected disparities and a MobileNetV2 backbone, in a base and a plus version.
summary: Fast-ACVNet (Xu et al. 2022): MobileNetV2 features; attention weights from a correlation volume (1/8 group-wise, propagated to 1/4; Fast-ACVNet+: 1/4) select the top-24 disparities of a concatenation volume, then a 3-D hourglass, top-2 soft-argmax and superpixel upsampling (max disparity 192).

papers.title: Accurate and Efficient Stereo Matching via Attention Concatenation Volume

task_io: Input: a rectified left / right image pair. Output: a disparity map (pixels, left view).
